guarantees.claim: When msg_strb does not match any listed pattern, funcpad_data is driven to all zeros.
When msg_strb == 7'b000_0000, funcpad_data[0] is 64'h0 and funcpad_data[1] is {end_of_block, 63'(funcpad)}.
When msg_strb == 7'b000_0001, funcpad_data[0] = {56'h0, msg_buf[0][7:0]} and funcpad_data[1] = {end_of_block, 55'(funcpad), msg_buf[1][7:0]}.
When msg_strb == 7'b000_0011, funcpad_data[0] = {48'h0, msg_buf[0][15:0]} and funcpad_data[1] = {end_of_block, 47'(funcpad), msg_buf[1][15:0]}.
When msg_strb == 7'b000_0111, funcpad_data[0] = {40'h0, msg_buf[0][23:0]} and funcpad_data[1] = {end_of_block, 39'(funcpad), msg_buf[1][23:0]}.
When msg_strb == 7'b000_1111, funcpad_data[0] = {32'h0, msg_buf[0][31:0]} and funcpad_data[1] = {end_of_block, 31'(funcpad), msg_buf[1][31:0]}.
When msg_strb == 7'b001_1111, funcpad_data[0] = {24'h0, msg_buf[0][39:0]} and funcpad_data[1] = {end_of_block, 23'(funcpad), msg_buf[1][39:0]}.
When msg_strb == 7'b011_1111, funcpad_data[0] = {16'h0, msg_buf[0][47:0]} and funcpad_data[1] = {end_of_block, 15'(funcpad), msg_buf[1][47:0]}.
When msg_strb == 7'b111_1111, funcpad_data[0] = {8'h0, msg_buf[0][55:0]} and funcpad_data[1] = {end_of_block, 7'(funcpad), msg_buf[1][55:0]}.

assumptions.claim: msg_strb must be one of the 8 valid byte‑strobe patterns: 0, 1, 3, 7, 15, 31, 63, 127.
assumptions.cond: always (to avoid triggering the default all‑zero path)
assumptions.risk: funcpad_data is forced to all zeros, yielding a wrong padding block and silently corrupting the SHA‑3 state and final digest.

uncertain_points.claim: Illegal msg_strb values (neither 0 nor a contiguous tail of ones) are not detected or flagged; the block silently outputs all‑zero funcpad_data.
uncertain_points.cond: msg_strb takes an unexpected value due to upstream logic error or fault injection
uncertain_points.risk: The SHA‑3 engine processes a zero‑filled padding block, leading to an incorrect digest with no error indication; this could be exploited to forge or bypass integrity checks.
